reader.requirement: At --std 85 an indexed file's FD admits the Sequential I-O RECORD clause in all three formats (CONTAINS integer-1; IS VARYING IN SIZE [FROM integer-2] [TO integer-3] [DEPENDING ON data-name-1]; CONTAINS integer-4 TO integer-5) with that clause's syntax rules (SR1-SR4) and general rules (record sizing, DEPENDING ON set by READ and read by WRITE/REWRITE, an output record outside integer-2..integer-3 unsuccessful with I-O status 44, READ INTO sending size). The witness covers formats 1 and 2 on the success path only.

edition-consulted.switches: the BYTES phrase is a COBOL-2023 construct: refused COBOL0900 at 85, accepted at 2023
DialectBehavior.RecordContainsRangeBindsRecordSize (2002 on): Format 3's integers bound WRITE/REWRITE only from 2002; at 85 Format 3 is fixed-by-record-description (GR13 implementor choice, GR15)
rule rows apply by Since edition and cite the 1985 rule (Of1985) below 2002; SR6 sentence names two sections at 85 (Sr6Sentence)

reader.notes: The indexed FD binds the same RecordClause path as sequential (FileDescriptionFormats row RECORD clause = All formats); every syntax rule refused with a 1985 citation and the runtime set status 44 for out-of-range WRITE/REWRITE lengths. Format 3 at 85 is treated as fixed-by-record-description (GR13 implementor-defined), not range-enforced.

refuter.evidence: Probes at --std 85 under refute-1985-231/runs. rix1-001 (indexed DYNAMIC, RECORD IS VARYING FROM 6 TO 12 DEPENDING ON XB-LEN PIC 99 COMP): WRITE 12/6/9 all 00 with LEN kept; failed random READ (23) left LEN 55; START 00 left LEN 55; READ NEXT set LEN 06 then 09; READ NEXT at end (10) left LEN 44; DELETE left LEN 07; REWRITE LEN 10 00; READ INTO sent 10 then 6 characters ([K003ZZZZZZ    ], [K002BB        ]), so GR8-GR12 hold on the indexed path including START, DELETE and READ NEXT, which the reader did not probe. rixodo-001: ODO record 6 to 20 under VARYING FROM 8 TO 20 refused COBOL2010 citing §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2 (GR5a minimum table count used). rixf1odo-001: ODO record 6 to 14 under RECORD CONTAINS 10 refused COBOL2010 (§1985:VII.3.8.3 SR1, GR5b maximum). cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR9; OK §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR2; OK §1985:VII.3.8.4 GR5. Indexed REWRITE size change is legal at level 2 (§1985:IX.4.6.4 GR3, read), so the reader's REWRITE LEN 12 00 is right.
